name: MLGym-Bench
description: MLGym-Bench is a benchmark suite within the MLGym framework for evaluating large language model agents on 13 diverse and open-ended AI research tasks spanning computer vision, NLP, reinforcement learning, and game theory. It assesses real-world AI research skills such as hypothesis generation, data processing, method implementation, experimentation, and iterative improvement.
reputation: A recent research benchmark from the MLGym framework that is gaining attention in the agentic AI research community, but it is not yet a widely standardized leaderboard benchmark.
notes: First Gym environment for ML tasks; supports adding new tasks and synthetic data generation; evaluates frontier LLMs; current models improve baselines but do not generate novel research contributions.
